column1: 4 questions. 4 different years. Hand-picked for difficulty and exam relevance.
Multi-method interaction with complex boolean logic. Most students write each method correctly in isolation but break the class as a whole.
Edge case on getAverageSteps when no active days. Instance variable management trips up students who skip careful reading.
Paired-element traversal logic with removal traps. One of the highest partial-credit failure rates of any released ArrayList FRQ.
The most recent released exam. Multi-condition 2D array logic that requires careful index management — exactly what the May 2027 exam will test.
This is not a lecture. Every FRQ was worked live, start to finish, and the recording keeps all of it.
